business_summary: Kissei Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells pharmaceutical products primarily in Japan and internationally. It offers Calogra tablets, for the treatment of ulcerative colitis; Tabneos capsules for the treatment of microscopic polyangiitis and granulomatous polyangiitis; Corsuba Intravenous Dialysis Syringe for the treatment of chronic idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura; Beova tablets for the treatment of overactive bladder treatment; and Darbepoetin Alfa BS injection JCR for the treatment of renal anemia. Its products in pipeline include CG0070, which is in Phase III clinical trial to treat non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer; Linzagolix, that is in Phase III clinical trial for the treatment of uterine fibroids and endometriosis; KDT-3594, which is in Phase II clinical trial to treat Parkinson's disease; KSP-0914 that is in Phase I clinical trial to treat Graves' disease; KPS-0373, that is in Phase III clinical trial to treat Spinocerebellar degeneration; KSP- 0576 that is in Phase I clinical trial to treat interstitial cystitis and bladder pain syndrome; and KSP-0930, which is in Phase I clinical trial to treat Narcolepsy. It also develops Silodosin for dysuria associated with benign prostatic hyperplasia; and Fostamatinib for tyrosine kinase inhibitor. In addition, it develops and sells protein controlled and energy supply food; purchases and sells related materials; and offers system development and information processing, facility and equipment management, and information gathering and development support services. Further, it engages in information equipment rentals; insurance agency business; manufactures and sells noodles; construction contracting; and computer system design and development, and cloud services. The company was formerly known as Kissei Yakuhin Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kissei Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. in October 1964. The company was incorporated in 1946 and is based in Matsumoto, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Kissei Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.는 주로 일본 및 해외에서 의약품을 연구, 개발, 제조 및 판매합니다. 궤양성 대장염 치료를 위한 칼로그라(Calogra) 정제를 제공합니다. 현미경적 다발혈관염 및 육아종성 다발혈관염 치료용 타브네오스 캡슐; 만성 특발성 혈소판 감소성 자반증 치료를 위한 Corsuba 정맥 투석 주사기; 과민성 방광 치료용 Beova 정제; 신장 빈혈 치료를 위한 Darbepoetin Alfa BS 주사 JCR. 파이프라인에 있는 제품에는 비근육침습성 방광암 치료를 위한 임상 3상 시험 중인 CG0070; 자궁근종 및 자궁내막증 치료를 위한 임상 3상 시험 중인 린자골릭스(Linzagolix); 파킨슨병 치료를 위한 임상 2상 시험 중인 KDT-3594; 그레이브스병 치료를 위한 임상 1상 시험중인 KSP-0914; 척수소뇌 변성 치료를 위한 임상 3상 시험 중인 KPS-0373; 간질성 방광염 및 방광통증증후군 치료를 위한 임상 1상 시험중인 KSP-0576; 기면증 치료제로 임상 1상을 진행 중인 KSP-0930 등이 있다. 또한 실로도스(Silodos)를 개발합니다.
